mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rates above 4.0% triggers a contraction in labor demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indicates robust economic growth, which drives higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both increase in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both proxies rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in the federal funds rate below 1.0% signals potential rate cuts, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1.0% in a month during late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle periods when FEDFUNDS drops below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected monthly increase in the CPIAUCSL index by over 0.5% signals rising inflation, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by 0.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL spikes by 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, driving investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and UNRATE both increase in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both labor indicators rise concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in HOUST (housing demand) reflects growing confidence in the housing market, which correlates with higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of HOUST trend increases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 1.5% triggers market concerns about future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 1.5% in a month during tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5% in a tightening cycle.
